# Governance record

The [canonical governance document](../GOVERNANCE.adoc) defines the maintainer's decision authority, contribution process and repository policies. The [maintainer record](../docs/MAINTAINERS.adoc) links participation and responsibility information.

This discovery entry supplies a documented `governance-tier` location without creating a second governance policy. The existing historical `docs/governance.adoc` is retained.
